title: Reading Drill — Improving copies of old floor plans — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Improving copies of old floor plans — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The plan archivist in Foxhaven received an old report about symbols on originals becoming difficult to read. The report compared incorrectly identified fixtures, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the reader checks rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered six weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include inaccurate original labels. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a keyed copy in clearer type as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
